slots.purpose: Primary navigation rail, between workspace tools and the account controls.
slots.context: Active workspace; active conversation if selected.
slots.example: Open a screen through one command.
slots.availability: Always mounted; the rail remains available when the sidebar is hidden.

slots.purpose: Bottom of the projects and chats sidebar, above connection status.
slots.example: Show extension status or open a tool.
slots.availability: Visible while the sidebar is open.

slots.purpose: Application titlebar, before extension screen/panel navigation and built-in tools.
slots.availability: Available across chat, settings, and extension screens.

slots.purpose: Top-right of the conversation content, below the application titlebar.
slots.context: The displayed conversation, project, worktree, and session.
slots.example: Inspect the conversation in a panel.
slots.availability: Mounted when the conversation is displayed; absent while a screen replaces it.

slots.purpose: Composer toolbar, between session controls and Send/Queue/Stop.
slots.context: Displayed conversation, worktree and session; composerReady.
slots.availability: Visible with the conversation; use enabledWhen: ["composerReady"] for draft-changing actions.

slots.purpose: Context strip above the draft, beside harness and node controls.
slots.context: Displayed conversation and its working context identifiers.
slots.availability: Visible with the composer; no DOM access to harness controls.

slots.purpose: Inside the composer, below its toolbar.
slots.availability: Empty text occupies no vertical status line. Nonempty status is announced with role="status".

slots.purpose: Each user or assistant message action row.
slots.context: Displayed conversation plus the exact messageId.
slots.example: Inspect this message in a panel.
slots.availability: Shown on hover or keyboard focus. Assistant action rows are hidden during generation.

slots.purpose: Below each message body and above its action row.
slots.context: Displayed conversation plus the exact messageId.
slots.availability: Visible on rendered user and assistant messages; plain text only.

slots.purpose: Project row in the sidebar, beside New chat and Project options.
slots.context: The row projectId; conversation, session and worktree identifiers are cleared.
slots.availability: Visible in expanded project navigation, including rows with no active conversation.

slots.purpose: Project options menu in the project row.
slots.context: The menu projectId; no conversation/session/worktree target; composerReady=false.
slots.example: Dispatch the same inspection command as the row action.
slots.availability: Available when that project options menu is open.

slots.purpose: Conversation actions menu in the titlebar and Chat options menu on every sidebar row.
slots.context: Titlebar: active conversation. Sidebar: the row conversationId, projectId, worktreeId and sessionId; composerReady=false.
slots.example: Inspect the menu target without selecting another chat.
slots.availability: Mounted inside the open menu. Both placements use the same slot name and command.

slots.purpose: Below the heading of the open conversation side panel.
slots.context: Active conversation plus panelId; extension panels retain the context that opened them, including messageId.
slots.example: Refresh or inspect the panel context.
slots.availability: Visible while a built-in or extension panel is open.

slots.purpose: After the content of the open conversation side panel.
slots.availability: Visible while a panel is open. Nonempty text is announced with role="status".

slots.purpose: Settings → Extensions, in the settings content area.
slots.context: Active workspace and conversation identifiers; composerReady=false.
slots.example: Dictation language settings, or a section action that opens a runtime screen.
slots.availability: Visible when Extensions is selected. Sections accept a title, text, and optional command; bundled modules may provide a trusted local renderer.
